chunks: Then he called to his Lord: "These are a sinful people."
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Hud pray when his people rejected his message?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Hud (peace be upon him) invokes divine justice against the 'Ad, marking the transition from patient preaching to the declaration of their guilt. Shia exegetes highlight this as a model of the 'clear warner' (mubin) who testifies to his people's obstinacy before the inevitable punishment, emphasizing the balance between mercy and justice in prophetic mission.
